Ticket:
Confused about patient portal account unlocking and password help

Hi there, I am really struggling to understand how we are supposed to help patients who get locked out of their online portal accounts. Yesterday and today, several people called the front desk because they forgot their passwords or couldn't get their dependent profiles to link properly. I tried going into the user administration settings to unlock them, but the buttons were grayed out or I just kept going in circles. Could someone please explain step-by-step how we are supposed to manage these password resets and account unlocks on our end?
